overview: 2026年，Bumi Armada 对已停止运营的间接全资子公司 Bumi Armada (Labuan) Ltd. 进行成员自愿清盘，属于精简架构的一部分；并宣派2025财年每股1仙的中期单层免税股息。
overview_en: In 2026, Bumi Armada undertook a members' voluntary winding-up of its dormant indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Bumi Armada (Labuan) Ltd. as part of a streamlining exercise;

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Bumi Armada (Labuan) Ltd. 进行成员自愿清盘，该公司自2024年起已停止运营并处于休眠状态，清盘完成后预计实现约2300万令吉的外汇储备收益（非现金）。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Bumi Armada (Labuan) Ltd. underwent a members' voluntary winding-up;

actions.title: ARMADA - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2025财年每股1仙的中期单层免税股息，除权日为2026年3月18日，派发日为2026年4月10日。
actions.text_en: Declared an interim single-tier tax-exempt dividend of 1 sen per ordinary share for FY2025, with ex-date 18 March 2026 and payment date 10 April 2026.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过成员自愿清盘退出已休眠的 Bumi Armada (Labuan) Ltd.，属于集团精简架构的一部分。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the dormant Bumi Armada (Labuan) Ltd. via members' voluntary winding-up as part of the group's streamlining exercise.
